flags.why: [Ánh](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/ánh) denotes a clove or an offset section of certain bulbs or tubers, rather than a sprout.
flags.fix: clove; offset or branch of certain bulbs or tubers

flags.why: The example refers to branches or sections of the ginger rhizome, not newly growing sprouts.
flags.fix: This piece of ginger has many branches.

flags.why: The common meaning [to record sound or images](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/thu), also used independently in expressions such as thu một bài hát, is missing.
flags.fix: verb | to record (sound or images); ex: Tôi vừa thu một bài hát. = I have just recorded a song.
